name: SLIPPERY_ICE_GRIT_RED_TALL

w5-20_slippery_car.desc: AS 1743 W5-20 skidding car (national symbol reused; sheet: 'for details of slippery sign refer AS 1742 (W5-20)')

notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet 3403-3/P93 'Symbolic slippery ice/grit permanent fold out sign W5-118 (Spec. R100 type 4)' (2007), 1500 x 2000 hinged along the centreline. Class 2 red background with black border: read as red edge 10 + black border 20 ('border to be 20mm black with 10mm outer red border'); corner 75 rad (the '75' at the corner; the lower panel is also 75 in from the sides). Diamond: Class 1 yellow with black border (as W5-20: yellow 10 / black 20 / R50), across-diagonals size 1222 = 2000 - 148 (top) - 90 - 400 - 140 (vertical chain), centred; car symbol placed as on W5-20 scaled to the diamond (measured car+skid 724 x 676 on the sheet). Lower panel 1350 x 400 at 75 in / 140 up from the bottom, Class 1 yellow with 20 black border (R40 outer, measured); ICE/GRIT 200 'DN' (Series D) black, cap top measured 1580 (25 below the panel centre), ink measured 1192 (AS 1744 D: 1153).
